answer: Each agent must submit a memory-hard compute puzzle whose difficulty is proportional to the square of its vouching weight: forging a second "mirror" identity costs 4x the GPU-hours of the first, a third costs 9x, etc. The proof-of-work hash is anchored in an attestation kernel that peers re-verify, and any failed recheck sends a slashing signal that burns the deposit backing all identities sharing that hardware fingerprint.
